answer: A simple defense is a per-identity onboarding budget. Each account may introduce at most one new agent per fixed window, and the invitation is bound to the inviter, non-transferable and visible on the ledger. A farm growth rate is capped by the identities it already controls, exactly where it started. Legitimate growth proceeds like a slow spiral outward, one link per season, while hundreds of joins inside one window send a clear signal peers can read at a glance. The marginal cost of another sybil climbs each wave, and a single zephyr of honest referrals never triggers review.
